body.name: Directed-realizable replicated-star stress test
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal K=\{f_1,\ldots,f_k\}\). For each \(j\in\{1,\ldots,m\}\) and \(i\in\{1,\ldots,k\}\), add vertices \(a_{ji},b_{ji}\), add a center \(c_j\), and use directed arcs \(a_{ji}\to f_i\), \(a_{ji}\to b_{ji}\), and \(b_{ji}\to c_j\). Add \(M\) private in-neighbors of each \(f_i\). The resulting WRI conflict graph consists of triangles \(\{f_i,a_{ji},b_{ji}\}\), edges \(b_{ji}c_j\), and the private core leaves.
